messages.subject: A question about BART
parts:
Hi, Young!

           I am so glad to read your latest released version including BART. But i am wondering,according to the original version of BART, the probability of bursting is dynamic,(ie, the balloon gets larger, the risk gets larger as well) . Based on your code, the experiment setting is that the probability is fixed or not?If it is fixed, I input my data(the design based on the original version,but the difference is the reward also increases in proportion as well) , can I get some meaningful reference from the output results?
           Thanks for your reading ,looking forward to your reply eagerly！



        Best wishes，
        Xinlei Ji

messages.author: 4bcf82a01cf98f56
messages.subject: Re: A question about BART
parts:
Hi Xinlei,

The bart_par4 model is based on Wallsten et al (2005) Psychological Review paper. In our Stan code (https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/master/exec/bart_par4.stan), 'p_burst' changes over pumps if that's what you are looking for. For more details of the model, please check out the paper. 

Best,
Young
